description: Find official health datasets (Eurostat, OECD, World Bank, IMF, WHO, national statistics offices). Use first to get dataset ids. Optional country and source filters. Returns dataset cards, not values.

country.description: Optional country name to prefer datasets covering it, e.g. 'Germany'.

query.description: What to find, e.g. 'unemployment rate' or 'GDP per capita'.

name: search_catalog
title: Search health statistics
